events.title: A quick update from the Cleaner Company Crew
events.summary: Hey everyone, We wanted to firstly say a big thank you to everyone who has jumped into the Cleaner Company Demo so far since launch, it's great to see so many of you jump in to help clean up the Galaxy! We’ve been keeping a close eye on your feedback, reports and discussions and we’re aware that some folks are running into bugs and other issues while playing the demo.
